methodology: Forward paper test at the first observed Gamma outcome price; hypothetical $10 stake per unique condition+outcome; current mark-to-market P&L is not realized profit and can change. Settlement requires a market explicitly marked closed/resolved by Gamma and a terminal outcome price. Current P&L is marked to market and does not count as a win. Ignores fees, slippage, partial fills and precise intrarun exits. Historical entry price is never backfilled. SELL observations are raw trade prints, not proof of full position exit.
